tools.title: Place-Value Blocks to 1,000
tools.description: Build three-digit numbers with hundreds flats, tens rods and ones cubes. Bundle and break apart blocks, and see standard, expanded and word form.
worksheet: Build 628. Write it in expanded form.
How many tens are in 340? (Hint: show it with only tens.)
34 tens
Build 9 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones. What number is it?
Build 715. Write it in word form.
seven hundred fifteen
How many hundreds make 1,000?
10 hundreds
Compare 482 and 428. Write >, = or <.
482 > 428, because 8 tens is more than 2 tens
Reflect: Why do we write a 0 in 405?
There are no tens. The 0 holds the tens place so the 4 still means 4 hundreds.

tools.title: Number Line Jumps
tools.description: Jump forward and back on an open number line by ones, tens and hundreds. Every trip becomes an addition or subtraction equation.
worksheet: Start at 56. Jump +10 three times. Where do you land? Write the equation.
Start at 74. Jump −10 four times. Where do you land?
Show 45 + 27 with jumps. Which jumps did you use? What is the sum?
For example +10, +10, +1 seven times (or +10, +10, +7). The sum is 72.
Show 92 − 18 by jumping back. What is the difference?
Count up from 68 to 100. How far is it?
32 (for example +2 to 70, then +10 three times)
Start at 450 and jump +100 three times. Where do you land?
Reflect: Why is it faster to jump by tens than by ones?
One jump of 10 does the work of ten jumps of 1.

tools.title: Arrays and Odd or Even
tools.description: Build arrays up to 5 rows and 5 columns and write the total as repeated addition. Pair up counters to see whether a number is odd or even.
worksheet: Make 2 rows of 5. Write an addition equation for the total.
Make 4 rows of 3. Write the total as repeated addition.
How many in all are in 5 rows of 5?
Is 13 odd or even? Write it as a double plus 1.
Is 18 odd or even? Write it as a double.
Find two different arrays with 12 in all (5 rows or fewer, 5 columns or fewer).
3 rows of 4 and 4 rows of 3
Reflect: How can you tell if a number is even by pairing counters?
If every counter has a partner, the number is even.

tools.title: Bar Model Builder
tools.description: Show word problems with tape diagrams: part-part-whole stories and compare stories. Hide the unknown, write the equation and check the answer.
worksheet: The parts are 26 and 18. What is the whole?
The whole is 50 and one part is 32. What is the other part?
Max read 64 pages. Zoe read 39 pages. How many more pages did Max read?
Sam had some marbles. He got 15 more. Now he has 40. How many did he have at first?
Draw a bar model for 57 − 23 and solve it.
Whole 57, one part 23, the other part is 34
Find two parts that make a whole of 100.
Any pair that adds to 100, for example 60 and 40
Reflect: How does a bar model help you choose to add or subtract?
If the whole is missing, add the parts. If a part is missing, subtract the known part from the whole.

tools.title: Clock to Five Minutes
tools.description: Move a clock by hours and five minutes, count by fives around the face, and choose a.m. or p.m. The digital time and the time in words update as you go.
worksheet: Show 4:35. Which number does the minute hand point to?
The 7
Show 9:50. How many minutes until 10:00?
10 minutes
Write quarter past 6 as a digital time.
What time is it 25 minutes after 3:00?
Do you eat breakfast at 7:30 a.m. or 7:30 p.m.?
Write half past 11 at night with a.m. or p.m.
Reflect: Why do we count by fives around the clock?
Each number on the clock is 5 more minutes, because there are 5 minutes between numbers.

tools.title: Coin and Bill Counter
tools.description: Add pennies, nickels, dimes, quarters and dollar bills. Count on from the biggest value, and find different ways to make the same amount.
worksheet: How much are 2 quarters, 1 dime and 3 pennies?
How much are 3 dimes and 4 nickels?
How many nickels make a quarter?
5 nickels
How much are one $1 bill and 2 quarters?
Make 47¢ with the fewest coins. Which coins did you use?
1 quarter, 2 dimes and 2 pennies (5 coins)
Ana has 80¢. She buys a pencil for 65¢. How much money is left?
Reflect: Why is it easier to count the coins worth the most first?
Big jumps first, then small ones: 25, 35, 45, 46, 47 is quicker than counting pennies first.

tools.title: Ruler and Line Plot
tools.description: Measure pencils with an inch or centimeter ruler, including pencils that do not start at 0, and record each length on a line plot.
worksheet: A pencil starts at 0 and ends at 6 on the inch ruler. How long is it?
6 inches
A pencil starts at 2 and ends at 9 on the inch ruler. How long is it?
7 inches (9 − 2 = 7)
Is a centimeter or an inch longer? Which unit gives a bigger number for the same pencil?
An inch is longer. Centimeters give the bigger number.
A line plot has × marks at 3, 5, 5, 6 and 7 inches. How many pencils were measured?
5 pencils
On that line plot, which length is the most common?
5 inches
How much longer is the longest pencil (7 in) than the shortest (3 in)?
4 inches
Reflect: Why do you count spaces on a ruler and not the marks?
Each space is one unit of length. Counting marks counts one too many.

tools.title: Picture and Bar Graph Builder
tools.description: Enter votes for favorite sports and see them as a picture graph, a bar graph and a table. Answer put-together, take-apart and compare questions.
worksheet: How many votes are there in all? (Soccer 7, Basketball 5, Tennis 4, Swimming 9)
How many more votes does Swimming have than Tennis?
5 more
How many more votes does Soccer have than Basketball?
2 more
If 4 more students vote for Tennis, how many votes will Tennis have?
Which sport has the shortest bar?
Tennis
How many students voted for Soccer or Basketball?
Reflect: How are a picture graph and a bar graph alike?
Both show the same counts. Each picture or each unit of a bar stands for 1 vote.

tools.title: Equal Shares and Square Grids
tools.description: Cut circles and rectangles into halves, thirds and fourths, color the shares, and build rectangles from rows and columns of same-size squares.
worksheet: Cut a circle into 3 equal shares. What is each share called?
A third (one third)
How many thirds make one whole?
3 thirds
Which is bigger: one third or one fourth of the same rectangle?
One third
A rectangle has 3 rows and 4 columns of squares. How many squares are there?
12 squares
Find another way to make a rectangle with 12 squares.
For example 2 rows of 6 (or 4 rows of 3, or 6 rows of 2)
Are equal shares of the same shape always the same shape? Explain.
No. Halves of a square can be two rectangles or two triangles — they are the same size, not always the same shape.
Reflect: Why must the shares be the same size to be called thirds?
Thirds are 3 equal shares. If the parts are different sizes, they are not thirds.
